Commands.Description: Run a normal Musoq query when a filesystem, interval, or query trigger fires. Interactive ANSI terminals refresh the latest successful table; redirected and machine-formatted output remains append-only. Routine Watch lifecycle telemetry is quiet unless --progress is supplied. Actions may keep durable rolling relations and compare them through watch.previous, history, and diff sources. Each trigger uses the standalone 'run' command grammar. Polling and AI-backed actions may incur cost.
